one_liner: Cloud-based messaging platform offering Bot API, MTProto API, Login/OIDC, and Gateway API for developers.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for Telegram and immediately obtain tokens via BotFather or developer tools for free.
verdict_reason: Telegram provides fully self-serve, free access to its Bot API, MTProto API, OIDC login, and Gateway API with documented credentials.

evidence.snippet: In the HTTP header: Authorization: Bearer
POST https://oauth.telegram.org/token Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded Authorization: Basic
You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
MCP server to work with Telegram through MTProto

agent_notes: Telegram offers multiple APIs (Bot API, MTProto, Gateway, OIDC Login). All core developer tools are self-serve and free.
